Wolfbrush Spear PiercingBasic
Deals 190% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG to a single enemy, with a 40% chance to inflict [Provoke] for 1 turn.
Bamboo VitalityActiveExclusive Lv.2
Shao Yun gains [Silent Force], lasting until the beginning of her next turn or the end of the next enemy's turn. While having [Silent Force], Shao Yun gains the following effects: 1. Immune to control effects and doesn't consume Stance value when counterattacking. 2. When the counterattack effect of Tactical Retaliation is triggered, there is a 100% chance to inflict [Deep Internal Injury II] on the attacker for 2 turns first. Meanwhile, changes the counterattack to casting Gust Attack. Afterward, removes [Silent Force]. 3. If Shao Yun hasn't triggered counterattack effect while having [Silent Force], restores self HP by 20% of her Max HP after the duration of [Silent Force] ends.
Gold Wolfbrush Spear Lv.2After casting Bamboo Vitality, grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns. Each time after Shao Yun triggers counterattack, reduces the CD of Bamboo Vitality by 1 turn.
Tactical RetaliationPassive
Shao Yun is considered to have [Counterattack] (not stackable) as long as she is alive. Each time Shao Yun triggers counterattack, she needs to consume 100 Stance value; if there is insufficient Stance value, counterattack cannot be triggered. Shao Yun will gain [Cohesion] (increases ATK by 40%) for 1 turn under the following circumstances: 1. When under enemies' basic attacks or taking Direct DMG from their skills. 2. When Gust Attack doesn't inflict a kill.
Gust AttackActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 4 stages of 170% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG each to a single enemy, with an 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Internal Injury] for 2 turns.
Gold Wolfbrush Spear Lv.1If counterattack hasn't been triggered while having [Silent Force], Shao Yun will cast Gust Attack (considered as counterattack) on a random enemy after [Silent Force] ends. At the beginning of each wave, if there is any ally from Sagacity Alliance except for Shao Yun on the battlefield, Shao Yun gains [Silent Force] for 1 turn.
Gold Wolfbrush Spear Lv.3If Gust Attack doesn't inflict a kill, inflicts [Severe Wound] and [Weakness II] on the target for 2 turns and grants self 1 layer of [Might Overload]. Each layer of [Might Overload] increases Gust Attack's DMG dealt by 180%, up to 2 layers. Removes all [Might Overload] after Shao Yun inflicts a kill. Also, for every 2 casts of Gust Attack, Shao Yun restores 400 Stance value immediately and gains 1 layer of [Unstoppable Strength] (each layer increases self Skill DMG dealt by 25%, up to 5 layers).
